title: Robin In The Hood
style: Hyper-speed heist rap with Afrikaans-flavored English licks, punchy dembow-leaning bounce, rapid-fire drum programming, synth sirens, chopped crowd shouts, and tense stop-start energy; verse drives like a getaway run, pre-chorus tightens into breathless countdowns, chorus hits with chanty gang vocals, doubled lead, and sharp delay throws on the anchor phrase; add reversed swells, tire-screech risers, and glassy stabs between lines; bright, aggressive, and cinematic with a hard-edged club mix, bounce, fake, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver, delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed, I can, you got this, man
We believe, Math Driver, three mirrors
Phonk track bounce, here’s my boys, thrash this toy
Take the right lane, hyper speed plane
Police chatter, sirens sound, unit three three six
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage, no relaxin’

[Pre-Chorus]
Extra stripe, no rage
Ain’t no time, turn page
Phonky, sneaky, thrift drift
Kick the floor, make it shift
Give them rage in our cage
Math Driver got the map
The architect, the plan
The dream done, safe done, sound

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood
But it’s for good!
Bust ’em like we should, ha bro, if we could
You heard the sarg?
Chase and cage
Thrash this toy
Catch that boy

[Verse 2]
Sand box city, eyes full of sand
Where are my toys? A bored stare like we care
Ground hog day, sand box say
But I forget what eight is for
Math driver, V.D.S. mansion
We go now, hyperspeed, no question
No way back, we go to stay
Escape this place, Math Driver, move that way
G4 hyperpeed, you got this boy
Delta track, D.J. Zyn, Rose
Pedals everywhere, rubber on the road
One more twist and the whole thing folds

[Pre-Chorus]
Ain’t no sleep, just run
One more lane, then done
Sirens high, pulse low
Everybody ready, go
Sand box city, break the frame
V.D.S. mansion, say my name
Math Driver, light the line
We get out clean this time

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood
But it’s for good!
Bust ’em like we should, ha bro, if we could
You heard the sarg?
Chase and cage
Thrash this toy
Catch that boy

[Bridge]
Next track, hands up, no delay
Sand box city fade away
Our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood
Next track, party lit, all good
V.D.S. mansion, party for me
V.D.S. mansion, party for me
Ain’t no cage, just open road
Math Driver, carry the load

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood
But it’s for good!
Bust ’em like we should, ha bro, if we could
You heard the sarg?
Chase and cage
Thrash this toy
Catch that boy
